617
Called Meeting of City Council
Austin Texas December 30, 1878
Mayor De Gress presiding
Present Aldermen Ergot, Brooker, Mil-
lett, Metz, Fann and Strong. 6.
Quorum present
The object of the Call being stated by the Mayor the following resolution was introduced
and unanimously adopted.
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, That the Mayor be and he is
hereby authorized to telegraph to Genl Cogt Commanding the department of Texas to Genl
Trevino
commanding the Mexican forces
on the Rio Grande, Mexico, inviting
them and their party to visit the City
of Austin; and if they accept this
invitation, that the Mayor is further
authorized to appoint a Committee
of five to escort them to this city.
On motion the Council then
adjourned.
Approved L. M. Bradley.
Jany 6 1879 City Clerk
